# NH Reader v0.8.0

**Release date:** 2026-10-28  
**Version Type:** Semantic Versioning (`v0.8.0`)

## ✨ Highlights

NH Reader v0.8.0 brings major user experience enhancements across browsing, reading, and navigation. The catalog experience pivots to a unified "Browse" view with inline sorting (Newest, Popular All Time, Popular This Week, Popular Today) and a dedicated "Random Doujin" discovery engine that strictly honors your client-side blacklist.

The reader view receives significant visual and layout polish: intrusive top gradients have been removed for pristine page legibility, the reader container is cleanly anchored below the persistent top title bar so window controls remain readily accessible, and the bottom dock conditionally hides during active reading sessions to maximize screen real estate.

Additionally, this release introduces an origin-listing "Up" navigation system on gallery details pages that seamlessly returns users to their exact originating feed (Browse, Search, Favorites, Downloads) while preserving scroll position and pagination.

Finally, NH Reader v0.8.0 ships with a complete, self-contained documentation suite in `docs/` covering 11 user guides and 10 developer architecture guides.

---

## 🚀 Key Improvements & Features

### 🧭 Browse & Navigation Pivot
- **Unified Browse Tab**: Renamed the "Latest" tab to "Browse" with a compass icon across the interface.
- **Dynamic Sort Controls**: Directly select between `Newest`, `Popular (All Time)`, `Popular This Week`, and `Popular Today` directly within the Browse toolbar without leaving the view. Sort preferences are reflected in the URL parameters for bookmarking.
- **Automatic `/popular` Redirection**: Legacy `/popular` routes now seamlessly perform client-side redirects to `/?sort=popular`.
- **Random Doujin Discovery**: Click the dice icon in the Browse toolbar to instantly jump to a randomized work. The backend checks your global blacklist and automatically re-rolls if any blacklisted tags match.

### 📖 Reader View Polish & Containment
- **Gradient Removal**: Eliminated intrusive top header gradients that caused page content rendering illegibility.
- **Header Anchoring & Containment**: Re-anchored the reader container (`top: 48px`, `z-index: 100`) beneath the system top bar (`z-index: 150`) so manga pages stay strictly within app boundaries while window controls remain accessible.
- **Dock Auto-Hiding**: Bottom navigation dock hides automatically during reading sessions.

### 🔙 Intelligent "Up" Navigation
- **Actions Row Integration**: Moved the Back button into the `.actions` row on the gallery details page, aligning its scale and styling with adjacent action chips.
- **Origin Listing Tracking**: Tracks navigation origins via SvelteKit `afterNavigate` in `src/lib/stores/navigation.svelte.ts` so returning "Up" always brings you back to your originating view with intact queries, filters, and scroll position.
- **Frame Padding Fix**: Restored standard `.page` frame padding (`padding: 20px 28px 48px; max-width: 1500px; margin: 0 auto;`) to prevent action buttons and cover art from clipping window edges.

### 📚 Comprehensive Documentation Architecture
- Authored a full `docs/` repository with 11 user guides (`getting-started`, `installation`, `browsing-and-search`, `blacklist`, `reader`, `library-favorites-history`, `downloads`, `account-and-api-key`, `settings`, `privacy-and-data`, `troubleshooting`) and 10 developer guides (`architecture`, `frontend`, `backend`, `data-and-storage`, `nhentai-api`, `i18n`, `development-setup`, `build-and-release`, `testing`, `conventions`).
- Retired all legacy external documentation hub references.

### 🌐 Internationalization (i18n)
- Added 13 new translation keys (`nav.browse`, `browse.*`, `common.back`) across all 17 community locale packs (`ar`, `de`, `es`, `fr`, `id`, `it`, `ja`, `ko`, `nl`, `pl`, `pt`, `ru`, `th`, `tr`, `vi`, `zh-CN`, `zh-TW`).
- Verified 100% key parity (292/292 keys) across all locales.
